## About
HEAL Veterinary Hospital is a full-service general care facility in Dallas. Alongside everyday care, we offer hard-to-find services like acupuncture, underwater and land treadmill rehabilitation, exercise conditioning, weight loss support, nutritional counseling and advanced dental services.
Our philosophy is to give sound medical advice and complete disclosure on recommended treatment plans and diagnostics. Dr. Brittney Barton and Dr. Robert Gaines lead a team that wants to be a partner in your pet's healthcare, especially as pets grow older and need help with pain and mobility.
Pet families rate us 4.6 from 84 Google reviews.

## Services
- Comprehensive Pet Care: General care and a broad range of procedures, with preventative care at the center.
- Acupuncture: One of the advanced services we offer, often part of a plan for pain and mobility.
- HEAL Pet Rehabilitation: Rehabilitation using a professional land treadmill, underwater treadmill and physical strengthening exercises.
- Pain Management: Pain management is one of Dr. Barton's passions, alongside senior pet care.
- Senior Care: Care for older pets as their needs change.
- Dentistry: Advanced dentistry for your pet.
- Surgery: Surgical support as part of our general medicine offering.

## FAQ
Q: Are you taking new patients?
A: Yes. We are accepting new clients and pet patients. Call us or fill out the appointment request form.

Q: What is your cancellation policy?
A: HEAL has a 24 hour cancellation policy. Cancelling less than 24 hours ahead may result in a cancellation fee.

Q: Who do I call when you're closed?
A: After hours, call the E-Clinic at (214) 520-8388.

## What customers say
- "HEAL Vet is one of a kind. Their holistic approach and the time they take to diagnose and treat is amazing. Over a year my once very, VERY active dog was experiencing accelerated mobility pain even when doing simple things like getting in the car or even sitting down. I had taken him to other vets that immediately suggested surgery, shots, or nothing. The thought that this would be his quality of life was so distressing. Then, I was referred to Dr. Martinson. Admittedly I was hesitant due to the cost and skeptical that something very costly would be recommended without results. Needless to say I was wrong and taking my dog there was the best decision I made, worth every penny and more. Dr. Martinson is a genius and, immediately knew where his pain was and what was causing it. The treatment were simple lifestyle changes to alleviate stress  on his knees and within 2 weeks I saw a huge difference and after a month, back to running and jumping at full force! They took the time to really understand my dog so as not to treat symptoms but the cause. I can’t recommend them enough." (Elizabeth Kastiel, 5/5)
- "Today was an exciting day! Ralf graduated from rehab and physical therapy at HEAL. Ralf ruptured a disc in the summer and became paralyzed in his hind legs. After his surgery I found HEAL and they quickly got me in for an evaluation with Dr. Gaines and we worked to develop a rehab plan based on Ralf's individual needs.

Lisa was assigned to Ralf for his physical therapy and took extra special care of him at each visit.This was important because the first few weeks we went 2xs a week and the progress he made was incredible. After his reevaluation we dropped down to 1x per week and after each visit there was a noticeable difference in how well he was recuperating. To say Ralf loved visiting with Lisa is an understatement because whenever we pulled up into the parking lot he got so excited and would even go looking for her after his acupuncture.

Everyone at HEAL is amazing to work with and truly care about their patients and their parents too." (PANJR 617, 5/5)
- "I’m a veterinarian myself and bring my almost 13 year old dog , Riley, to Dr. Gaines and Lisa (his PT nurse) for once weekly acupuncture, water treadmill, laser,  and massage therapy. I cannot express how much his rehab has improved his quality of life. I am so thankful for the HEAL staff for helping keep Riley comfortable in his senior years when medication alone wasn’t helping with arthritis of his hips and neck/back pain.
I have referred many senior pet parents to HEAL when medications alone aren’t enough and everyone has been super happy with their experience!" (Briana Arroyo, 5/5)
